intent: Multi-select or confirmation control. Optional visible label.
useWhen: Independent booleans such as agree to terms or enable notifications
Confirmations that are not a submit action
Table row or icon-only select without visible text — set ariaLabel
doNotUseWhen: Choosing one of several options — use RadioGroup
Primary form submit actions — use Button

label.note: visible text; required unless ariaLabel is set

ariaLabel.note: required when label is omitted (table row, icon-only slot)

indeterminate.note: visual + aria-checked mixed; set via input.indeterminate

requirements: Visible label via label/htmlFor OR aria-label when no text
Error described if used with Field
Do not ship unlabeled without ariaLabel

doNot: Do not use RadioGroup for booleans
Do not ship unlabeled without ariaLabel
snippet:
<Checkbox id="updates" label="Send me product updates" />
<Checkbox id="row-1" ariaLabel="Select row" />
